newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brest airport Jan-Nov 96 cargo traffic up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brest airport Jan-Nov 96 cargo traffic up 25 pct.

text.p: Brest's Guipavas airport said it handled 3,044 tonnes of cargo traffic in the first 11 months of 1996, an increase of 25 percent on the same period in 1995.

One of the main factors in the growth in traffic in 1996 had been the buoyant demand for fish and seafood exports from Brittany to Paris, the south of France and Corsica, transported in the bellyholds of scheduled passenger services, an airport authority official told Reuters.
Postal traffic was down 0.9 percent on the first 11 months of last year at 1,771 tonnes, the airport authority said.
French airline L'Aeropostale carries overnight mail between its Paris Charles-de-Gaulle hub and Brest on a regular basis using a five-tonne capacity Fokker 27 aircraft.
